name: Netorare Maid
source:
There is a man and woman in the big premises, Roi, the son of the premises' owner who passed away a long time ago, and a beautiful maid Urae. Their destiny changes by the appearance of an old man....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ030158.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在一座偌大的宅邸里生活着一对男女——早已离世的前任宅邸主人的儿子罗伊，以及美丽的女仆乌拉埃。随着一名老人的出现，两人的命运迎来了翻天覆地的改变……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ030158.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
